build_diffusion_terms: build diffusion terms of a discrete matrix equation from face diffusivity and cell variable geometry
create_tridiagonal_matrix: create a tridiagonal matrix representing 1D diffusion operator coefficients with upper and lower off-diagonals
apply_dirichlet_boundary: apply Dirichlet boundary conditions to diffusion matrix rows at left and right faces
apply_gradient_boundary: apply gradient (Neumann) boundary conditions to diffusion matrix rows at left and right faces
validate_boundary_constraints: validate that exactly one boundary constraint type is set at each face using chex assertions
